run_docca_cli: run docca to convert Doxygen XML index file into QuickBook markup output
parse_doxygen_xml: parse a Doxygen XML index file and collect compound references for classes and namespaces
collect_compound_data: collect and parse Doxygen compound XML files into Entity objects like Class, Namespace, and Struct
render_jinja2_template: render a Jinja2 template with parsed Doxygen entity data to produce QuickBook documentation output
load_docca_extensions: load Python extension modules and install them into the Jinja2 environment for custom template filters
